limitations: Every historical period has previously been inspected in other experiments; neural development does not make it an untouched independent test.
The source coverage is fixed: E0 ends2026-11-08, E1 ends2026-11-07, E2 ends2026-11-04. More recent results are not invented or silently joined.
Days since last same-league game are not total squad rest: cups, international duty and exact final-whistle publication timestamps are missing.
E2 starts2020. Early E2 features can have no history; flags and fallback frequencies are retained rather than dropping these fixtures or borrowing future seasons.
Smoothed feature priors are explicitly fixed pseudo-counts, not observed shots or measured xG. Coverage distinguishes missing values from observed zero.
Synthetic XOR and gradient tests validate implementation; they are not football performance results or architecture selection.
A richer model can overfit. An unchanged or worse later score means retaining the current model; do not retune on those later outcomes.
All original100, ELC36 and related future packets remain unchanged. No new daily neural job or extra paid provider is authorized by historical scores alone.
